quests.title: Getting Started
quests.description: Welcome to EcoQuest! Complete your first environmental actions and learn how the platform works.

missions.title: Welcome to EcoQuest
missions.description: Read about environmental protection and take the welcome quiz

content.text: Environmental protection is crucial for our planet's future. Every small action counts!

quiz.question: What is the main goal of environmental protection?
options: To preserve nature for future generations

missions.title: Complete Your Eco Profile
missions.description: Make sure your profile is fully set up with your interests

missions.title: Take Your First Eco Action
missions.description: Choose one eco-friendly action to do today (turn off unused lights, use a reusable water bottle, etc.)

actions: Turn off lights when leaving a room
Walk or bike instead of driving

quests.title: Water Conservation Champion
quests.description: Learn about water conservation and implement water-saving techniques in your daily life.

missions.title: Water Facts Quiz
missions.description: Test your knowledge about water conservation

content.text: Water is precious! Did you know that only 3% of Earth's water is fresh water?

quiz.question: How much water does the average person use per day?
Which uses more water: a 5-minute shower or filling a bathtub?

missions.title: Home Water Audit
missions.description: Check for water leaks and wastage in your home

checklist: Time your shower (aim for under 5 minutes)
Look for water stains that indicate leaks

actions: Use a bucket to collect shower water while it warms up
Turn off tap while brushing teeth
Only run dishwasher/washing machine with full loads

quests.title: Waste Warrior
quests.description: Master the art of waste reduction, recycling, and proper disposal.

missions.title: Personal Waste Audit
missions.description: Track your waste production for 3 days

content.instructions: For 3 days, note down all waste you produce. Categorize as: recyclable, compostable, or landfill.

missions.title: Set Up Recycling System
missions.description: Create a proper recycling system in your space

requirements: Set up separate bins for different waste types
Create compost bin for organic waste

content.challenge: Reduce your daily waste by 50% for one week using reuse and reduction strategies

quests.title: Energy Efficiency Expert
quests.description: Become an expert in energy conservation and renewable energy solutions.

missions.title: Home Energy Audit
missions.description: Assess your home's energy usage and identify areas for improvement

checklist: Check for air leaks around windows and doors
Check insulation in walls and attic

missions.title: Energy Saving Implementation
missions.description: Implement energy-saving measures in your daily life

actions: Unplug electronics when not in use

missions.title: Renewable Energy Research
missions.description: Research renewable energy options for your area

content.task: Research and create a report on renewable energy options (solar, wind, hydroelectric) available in your region
